report_name: Ransomware Attacks Target End-of-Life Synology NAS Devices

threat_actors.name: Synology Ransomware Attackers
threat_actors.description: Unnamed threat actors conducting a ransomware campaign targeting end-of-life Synology NAS devices by exploiting a known vulnerability patched in 2024.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The ransomware payload encrypts user and business data on compromised Synology NAS devices, and a ransom is demanded for decryption.

attack_patterns.name: Active Scanning
attack_patterns.description: Attackers continuously scan the internet for exposed Synology NAS login portals to find vulnerable devices.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exploit a known vulnerability (patched in 2024) in the public-facing DiskStation Manager (DSM) to gain unauthorized access to the NAS device.

vulnerabilities.name: Synology DSM Vulnerability Patched December 2024
vulnerabilities.description: A known vulnerability in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM), patched in December 2024, is being exploited to gain access to devices running end-of-life software versions that did not receive the security update.

indicators.name: Generic Ransom Note Creation (README.txt)
indicators.pattern:
title: Generic Ransom Note Creation (README.txt)
id: 3b8a1e9c-7f5d-4b2a-9c6e-0d1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a file named README.txt, which is a common name for ransom notes dropped by ransomware.
references:
  - https://www.hkcert.org/security-bulletin/security-alert-ransomware-attacks-targeting-synology-nas-devices_20261102
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-02
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\README.txt'
      - '/README.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of a file named README.txt, which is a common name for ransom notes dropped by ransomware, as mentioned in the pre-extracted cyber observables.

indicators.name: Network Traffic to Synology DSM Ports
indicators.pattern:
title: Network Traffic to Synology DSM Ports
id: 8d2c1b9a-5d7f-4a2b-9c6e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: Detects network traffic targeting Synology DSM default management ports (5000/HTTP, 5001/HTTPS), which could indicate active scanning by threat actors.
references:
  - https://www.hkcert.org/security-bulletin/security-alert-ransomware-attacks-targeting-synology-nas-devices_20261102
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-02
tags:
  - attack.t1595
level: medium
logsource:
  category: firewall
detection:
  selection:
    dst_port:
      - 5000
      - 5001
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate remote administration traffic.
indicators.description: Detects network traffic targeting Synology DSM default management ports (5000/HTTP, 5001/HTTPS), which could indicate active scanning by threat actors as mentioned in the pre-extracted cyber observables.

relationships.source_name: Network Traffic to Synology DSM Ports
